result.detail: Timing: the clock period is 40 ns. Inputs change only at 1 ns or more after a rising edge. The model updates on the same edge using nonblocking assignments. Outputs are read 1 ns after each addr change, so the testbench does not race the design. Map from spec statements to tests: IRQ-RESET is S0 and S5. IRQ-REG-RW and IRQ-PARAM are S1, with ENABLE and MODE reads on all three copies. IRQ-READ is the per-cycle sweep of all four addresses, which uses reads only, plus the model check. IRQ-LEVEL and IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED are S2. IRQ-EDGE is S3. IRQ-W1C is S1 (a write never sets a bit) and S2 (bits written 0 stay set). IRQ-ACK is S4: numbers of N or more on N=8 and N=3, upper wdata bits ignored, and source 31 on N=32. IRQ-SET-WINS is S2 for level sources and S3 for edge sources. IRQ-MASK and IRQ-PRIORITY are S4: several sources pending, a lower source disabled, first and last source, and irq_id 0 while irq is low. IRQ-CLAIM is the CLAIM reads in S2 and S4 (N=8, N=32). IRQ-LATENCY is the check after every edge. Open risk: the name of the nonce plusarg is not in my inputs. If the gate rejects the verdict for a nonce mismatch, the fix is to change that one lookup. Suggested follow-up for review: run against mutants, such as reversed priority or a clear that wins over detection, to confirm the checks fail.
